title: New in Symfony 8.2: Single-Use and Safer Signed URLs
content:
<html><head></head><body>Signed URLs let you share links that can't be tampered with, such as password
reset links, email confirmation links or download links. Symfony provides the
UriSigner utility to create and check them, and login links to log in
users without a password. Symfony…</body></html>
